capabilities: Render labels on fenced code blocks via curly-brace syntax
Optionally display the code language as a fallback label
Style labels with CSS via the codeblock-label class
extras: Does not support Live Preview mode; a known bug means label edits may not trigger preview updates, requiring manual changes elsewhere in the block. Author accepts pull requests for live preview support.
intentEvidence: This plugin is based off of the template plugin here
problem: Obsidian's fenced code blocks show no title or label, so it is hard to mark what a block is for or name it.

summary: Renders labels on fenced code blocks using a curly-brace syntax, with an optional language-name fallback label.
